## [3.68.0] - 2026-08-27

### Features

- allow no initial edit-line focus
- configure edit-line initial cursor field
- preserve reverted 3.67.0 progress for review

### Bug Fixes

- preserve monotonic version and branch provenance
- restore fixed employee validation for phone split captures
- ensure proper initialization of employee loading provider
- preserve multiline line notes
- focus editable field for repair lines
- preserve edit cursor across presets
- reveal initially focused edit field
- submit line edits with enter
- select initial edit-line field value
- make pending report acknowledgements atomic
- keep file logging after retention cleanup failure
- auto-scroll customer display cart for Jira 216
- throttle log retention cleanup
- restore doc counter floor for sync push
- require external Nayax card terminals
- harden local log retention and bulk sqlite operations
- preserve local custom layout metadata
- restore POS layout preset from Odoo settings

### Other Changes

- align picking assertion with shared API helper
- update legacy internal card widget expectations
- pair development with validated API
- pair private build with preserved API
- Refactor credit method identification and update UI to conditionally display Fast Credit button based on journal type
- Fix Nayax VUID generated after durability attempt begins
